Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the director by conflating the 1933 film “Gently My Songs Entreat” (Leise flehen meine Lieder), which the WebSurfer’s results clearly showed was directed by Willi Forst, with the separate 1934 British film “Unfinished Symphony” directed by Anthony Asquith. This wrong pivot to Asquith led the team to pursue the wrong person’s birthplace.
